properties.displayName: EntraOps Privileged EAM Parser for Custom Table
properties.query:
// Returns the latest completed run per RBAC system (completion marker after its last record).
// The lookback must cover the collection schedule.
let LookbackPeriod = 14d;
let IngestionWindow = 10m;
let RunMarkerType = "EntraOpsIngestionRun";
let EntraOpsData = PrivilegedEAM_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackPeriod);
let Records = EntraOpsData
    | where ObjectType != RunMarkerType;
let RunMarkers = EntraOpsData
    | where ObjectType == RunMarkerType
    | project RoleSystem, MarkerTime = TimeGenerated;
let LatestRun = RunMarkers
    | summarize LatestMarker = max(MarkerTime) by RoleSystem;
let PreviousRun = RunMarkers
    | lookup kind=inner LatestRun on RoleSystem
    | where MarkerTime < LatestMarker
    | summarize PreviousMarker = max(MarkerTime) by RoleSystem;
let RunBounds = LatestRun
    | lookup kind=leftouter PreviousRun on RoleSystem
    | extend PreviousMarker = iff(isnull(PreviousMarker), LatestMarker - LookbackPeriod, PreviousMarker);
// A data collection rule that keeps TimeGenerated returns the records of the run with exactly the marker time.
// A rule that sets TimeGenerated at ingestion returns them between the previous and the latest marker.
let ExactRuns = Records
    | lookup kind=inner RunBounds on RoleSystem
    | summarize ExactRecords = countif(TimeGenerated == LatestMarker) by RoleSystem;
let CompletedRunRecords = Records
    | lookup kind=inner RunBounds on RoleSystem
    | lookup kind=leftouter ExactRuns on RoleSystem
    | where (ExactRecords > 0 and TimeGenerated == LatestMarker)
        or (coalesce(ExactRecords, 0) == 0 and TimeGenerated > PreviousMarker and TimeGenerated <= LatestMarker)
    | project-away LatestMarker, PreviousMarker, ExactRecords;
// Data ingested before the completion marker existed: the latest ingestion of the RBAC system
let UnmarkedLatestIngestion = Records
    | where RoleSystem !in ((RunMarkers | distinct RoleSystem))
    | summarize LatestTimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated) by RoleSystem;
let UnmarkedRecords = Records
    | lookup kind=inner UnmarkedLatestIngestion on RoleSystem
    | where TimeGenerated > LatestTimeGenerated - IngestionWindow
    | project-away LatestTimeGenerated;
union CompletedRunRecords, UnmarkedRecords
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ObjectId,RoleSystem
| project-away TenantId
| extend Type = "EntraOps_CustomTable"
| mv-apply RoleAssignments on
(
    extend SubType = tostring(RoleAssignments.RoleAssignmentSubType)
    | extend RoleAssignments = bag_merge(
        RoleAssignments,
        bag_pack(
            "EligibilityBy", case(
                RoleSystem == "EntraID" and RoleAssignments.PIMAssignmentType == "Eligible" and SubType in ("Eligible member", "Nested Eligible member", "Nested Eligible group member"), "PIM for Entra ID Roles and Groups",
                RoleSystem == "EntraID" and RoleAssignments.PIMAssignmentType == "Eligible", "PIM for Entra ID Roles",
                RoleSystem == "Azure" and RoleAssignments.PIMAssignmentType == "Eligible", "PIM for Azure Roles",
                SubType in ("Eligible member", "Nested Eligible member", "Nested Eligible group member"), "PIM for Groups",
                "N/A"),
            "TransitiveByPim", SubType in ("Eligible member", "Nested Eligible member", "Nested Eligible group member")
            )
        )
    | summarize RoleAssignments = make_list(RoleAssignments)
)
| project-reorder 
    TimeGenerated,
    ObjectId,
    ObjectType,
    ObjectSubType,
    ObjectDisplayName,
    ObjectUserPrincipalName,
    ObjectAdminTierLevel,
    ObjectAdminTierLevelName,
    OnPremSynchronized,
    AssignedAdministrativeUnits,
    RestrictedManagementByRAG,
    RestrictedManagementByAadRole,
    RestrictedManagementByRMAU,
    RoleSystem,
    Classification,
    RoleAssignments,
    Owners,
    OwnedObjects,
    OwnedDevices,
    AssociatedWorkAccount,
    AssociatedPawDevice,
    Type
